attempted_claim: Let X4 be the smooth toric 5-ray surface obtained by first blowing up P^2 at p1=[1:0:0] for the standard 2-torus action and then blowing up the torus-fixed point q on the first exceptional divisor E1 at the intersection of E1 with the strict transform of the coordinate line through p1, with H* the pullback of the hyperplane class, E1t the pullback of E1, E2 the second exceptional divisor, H the divisor class induced by H*, and pt the point class. Let beta4=4H*-2E1t-2E2 in H_2(X4;Z) and let Mbar_{0,3}(X4,beta4) be the genus-zero three-pointed stable-map moduli space with psi_i and ev_i for i=1,2,3. What is the exact rational value of <tau_2(pt),tau_1(pt),tau_2(H)>_{0,3,beta4}^{X4}=integral over the virtual class of psi_1^2 ev_1^*(pt) cup psi_2^1 ev_2^*(pt) cup psi_3^2 ev_3^*(H)? A complete answer is a single explicit rational number N4 asserted to equal that virtual integral for exactly this iterated blow-up surface, class, three markings, and stated descendant insertion profile.
decisive_failure: The localization setup (fan, degree distributions, weights, dimension balance) was verified by bounded computation, but the full decorated graph sum was not implemented or summed, so no exact value, bound, or vanishing statement for N4 is established; all conclusions about infeasibility within the clock are session-scoped and do not imply anything about the true value of the invariant.
